misassignment_rule: a return is misassigned when it is nearer in full complex distance to the other drawn source; 2 x 200 draws; not a new threshold, an assignment
phi_formula: Phi(-d/2), d = ||R (s1 - s2)||, R the real-source unit-noise stack, two known real signals, equiprobable, noise only. For complex noise E|n|^2 = sigma^2 this is d = sqrt(2) ||T (s1 - s2)|| / sigma
